{{Quote|Are you all right?''"<br />"''Yes, but this slave outfit isn't exactly warm. And the chain pinches and the collar chafes.''"<br />"''The old saying's right, Leia: Beauty can be a curse.|Lando Calrissian and Leia Organa, while Jabba the Hutt's retinue sleeps|<ref name="Return of the Jedi: The National Public Radio Dramatization">[[Return of the Jedi: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''Return of the Jedi'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref>}}
'''Huttese slave-girl costumes''' were [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] worn by [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] dancers who were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] or employed by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. They typically consisted of an ornamented metal harness on top with varying garments on the lower half, and they revealed the wearer's [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], [[Breast/Legends|chest]], and abdomen. When [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] captured [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] at his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]], he forced her to wear a costume as one of his dancing girls, but she strangled him to [[Death/Legends|death]] with the chain he put on her.

==Description==
Huttese slave-girl costumes were [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] worn by [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] who were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]<ref name="Shield of Lies" /> or employed by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as dancers.<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> The top half included a slave girl harness<ref name="TVD" /> that fastened with cords and had filigree on the [[Breast/Legends|chest]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The lower half varied, but could be an ornamented bikini-style bottom layered over trousers<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> or worn with thigh-high stockings,<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> or a metal belt with a [[Lashaa silk/Legends|lashaa silk]] skirt<ref name="TVD" /> or a loincloth.<ref name="KOTOR II" /> It was worn with jewelry, and enslaved beings also wore a collar on the neck to which a chain could be attached.<ref name="ROTJ" /> In Leia Organa's case, the bikini was also made to reveal any possible weapons that could be concealed.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
===The Old Republic===
{{Quote|Excellent, I'll just need you to put this on and dance a little, nothing fancy. I just need to make sure you'll pass.''"<br />"''Wait - did you say put something on?''"<br />"''Er, just an outfit. Very simple, something that all Vogga's dancers wear.|[[Vogga]]'s majordomo and [[Meetra Surik]] discuss a dancer's outfit|<ref name="KOTOR II" />}}
After the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Meetra Surik]] needed to negotiate a solution for shipments of [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]] fuel for the [[Telosian Restoration Project]]. The [[Exchange]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[G0-T0|Goto]] was disrupting [[Vogga]] the Hutt's business on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. To gain an audience with Vogga, Surik considered a job offer from Vogga's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] to become a new dancer for the Hutt or procure another candidate for him. Dancers were required to be young, female, and wearing a dancer's outfit.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

During the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], enslaved women wore dancer's outfits to perform in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], such as the [[Slippery Slopes Cantina]] in the [[Promenade]] and [[Club Ufora]] in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] on Nar Shaddaa. Free beings also purchased and wore attire in the same style.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[File:Shaliqua.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Diva Shaliqua at the Boonta Eve Classic]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a green-haired human wearing a gold costume was in the company of the Hutt crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Disilijic Tiure]] when [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] met with him.<ref name="Star Wars 1998 8">[[Star Wars (1998) 8|''Star Wars'' (1998) 8]]</ref> During the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that same year,<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Jabba brought with him the half-[[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Diva Shaliqua/Legends|Diva Shaliqua]], whom he had enslaved,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|143|Shaliqua, Diva}}</ref> to his [[Jabba's private box|private box]] at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]]. Shaliqua wore a slave-girl costume of the style that included baggy trousers, chunky metal bangles on both wrists, leather armbands on both arms, and a collar.<ref name="TPM" />

The [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] disguised herself in the dancing garb during the [[Infant of Shaa]] incident in order to seduce [[Dreddon]], a Hutt criminal with a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head. Once the two were alone together, Wesell killed him.<ref name="Star Wars: Jango Fett">[[Star Wars: Jango Fett (one-shot)|''Star Wars: Jango Fett'']]</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an underground establishment called [[Show Girls/Legends|Show Girls]] advertised itself on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with images of a female [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] in a slave-girl costume.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> When [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] was imprisoned at [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's Palace]] on Nal Hutta, three Twi'lek chorus girls performed for the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] with Ziro's lover, the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]. Their costumes paired harnesses with matching bikini-style bottoms, along with stockings and [[Leather/Legends|leather]] strapping wrapped around their legs and collars on their necks. They wore headdresses crowned with vibrantly-colored feathers and styled to resemble the heads of specific Hutts, such as Jabba and [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />

On [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], a male [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] displayed a female Twi'lek clad in a slave-girl costume to a fellow Zygerrian and a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]].<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref> At another time on Nal Hutta, several Twi'leks wore the outfit in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bilbousa/Legends|Bilbousa]], including a pair who escorted a drunken Sy Snootles out of a [[Bilbousa saloon/Legends|saloon]] while others provided entertainment inside.<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>

===The Imperial Period===
The [[Twin/Legends|twin]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilots [[Tia (pilot)|Tia]] and [[Ghia]] were both forced to wear slave-girl costumes during their capture and imprisonment by Jabba the Hutt. The sisters had come to Tatooine in an ill-planned attempt to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], whom they had both fallen in love with. However, they were both quickly captured and enslaved. Tia and Ghia were forced to feed and massage Jabba, as well as participate in the Hutt's [[Jabba's demolition games|demolition games]]. They were eventually rescued by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who had also participated in the demolition games<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''</ref> disguised as the male [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] bounty hunter [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Organa snuck them out of the palace and to a rebel transport.<ref name=":0" /> The musician [[Jess/Legends|Jess]] wore a costume that had blue leggings and a solid brassiere while in servitude to Jabba.<ref name="ROTJ" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Organa, once again disguised as Boushh, [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|infiltrated]] Jabba the Hutt's palace, with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] seemingly the bounty hunter's captive. They planned to rescue Han Solo from imprisonment in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. Organa freed Solo from the carbonite, but the Hutt had witnessed them and had Solo taken to his dungeon.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Two of Jabba's enslaved dancers removed Organa's disguise to dress her as another dancing girl while the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] and his [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|band]] played the [[Music/Legends|song]] "[[Ode to a Radioactive Ruin]]." The garb that Organa was forced to wear included a [[Gold/Legends|gold]]<ref name="And the Band Played On" /> brassiere harness, a lashaa silk split skirt suspended from front and rear plates, and [[Jerba/Legends|jerba]] leather [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="TVD" /> Her [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was styled in a high braided bun and then left to hang in a long plait down her back. She also wore metal accessories: small hoop [[Piercing/Legends|earrings]], hair ornaments, a cuff in a spiral design on her upper left arm, a [[Bracelet/Legends|bracelet]] on her right wrist, and a heavy [[Shock collar/Legends|collar]] around her neck through which a heavy chain was threaded.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Rebo, in his gluttonous Ortolan nature, felt sorry for Organa; he thought she looked malnourished and in need of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], so he snuck her a [[blatberry pie]] from the kitchens.<ref name="And the Band Played On" />

When Jabba had Organa sent to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] quarters one night as a gift, Fett instead gave Organa a sheet to cover herself. Organa offered to pay Fett if he assisted in the escape, but he declined and said the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was morally wrong for starting a war with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. They debated the morality of her friends before Fett went to sleep.<ref name="The Last One Standing">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> Other beings in Jabba's Palace were sympathetic to Organa, such as the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] who offered to sneak her some food. When Jabba suspected Porcellus of putting ''[[Fierfek/Legends|fierfek]]'' in his fricasseed [[sandmaggot]] [[Kidney/Legends|kidneys]], Organa ate a sample despite becoming nauseated.<ref name="Taster's Choice">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

[[File:Jabbachoke.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Using the chains he put on her, Leia Organa strangles and kills Jabba Desilijic Tiure.]]
Organa managed to get some sleep<ref name="Taster's Choice" /> after speaking briefly with the undercover [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]<ref name="Fast Friends">{{RJRadio|Fast Friends"}}</ref> before [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] entered the palace, and he defeated Jabba's [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]] while Organa watched. Jabba sentenced Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca to [[Death/Legends|death]] by [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] digestion in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], and brought Organa alongside him in his [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]]. As Lando joined the group to [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fight back]] against the scheduled execution, Organa knocked out the controls to Jabba's throne, grabbed her chains, and threw them around the Hutt's neck to strangle and kill him.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Organa's victory over the Hutt was witnessed by many beings, including Max Rebo, Sy Snootles,<ref name="And the Band Played On" /> [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]],<ref name="Goatgrass">{{StoryCite|story=Goatgrass: The Tale of Ree-Yees|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]],<ref name="Of the Day's Annoyances">{{StoryCite|story=Of the Day's Annoyances: Bib Fortuna's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> and [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]].<ref name="A Free Quarren in the Palace">{{StoryCite|story=A Free Quarren in the Palace: Tessek's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> 

As they flew away from Tatooine in the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', Leia and Han, separated in an uncertain moment in their relationship, allowed themselves a moment of flirtatious banter. Han casually asked Leia if she planned to keep the costume, to which she coyly replied, "We'll see."<ref name="Prophecies and Destinies">{{RJRadio|Prophecies and Destinies}}</ref>

===The New Republic===
{{Quote|We might want to think about making you a bit more available to the grids, not only the big ones based here, but the regional and local nets&mdash;''"<br />"''Now you want me to give interviews? What next? Preside over spaceport openings? Endorse a line of little Leia dolls? Let myself be recorded dancing for Han in a Huttese slave-girl costume?''"<br />"''Now, Leia, no one is suggesting&mdash;''"<br />"''You'd get there, eventually. And that's not what I'm here to do.|Nanaod Engh and Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Shield of Lies" />}}
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Kir Kanos]], disguised as the bounty hunter Kenix Kil, delivered [[Tarrant Snil]] to the Hutt crime lord [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]]. To celebrate, Grappa threw a party that featured several dancers performing while wearing slave-girl costumes.<ref name="Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 2">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 2|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 2]]</ref>

Luke Skywalker visited a bar called [[Jabba's Throne Room]], a faithful replica of the room in Jabba's palace. Noting that many of the waitresses are scantily-clad and upon hearing the name Leia, he feared the evening's entertainment would be a lookalike of his twin sister. Later, the [[First Administrator]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[New Republic General Ministry|General Ministry]], [[Nanaod Engh]], encouraged [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] Leia Organa Solo to buff up her public image. She responded by sarcastically asking if she was meant to give interviews or be recorded dancing for Han in a Huttese slave-girl costume.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />

The outfit appeared in a vision to Leia Organa Solo as she struggled to come to terms with her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers. She saw herself having two possible fates. In one, she would be the [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] of the Galactic Empire, having ascended the throne of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]; in the other, she had given up and was crying at the foot of that throne. While the latter wore the scraps of gold and silk with shame, the Empress Leia wore it under a robe with flashing jewels as a shining symbol of strength and power.<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HfZ_musical_concept.png|thumb|left|250px|Concept art from "Hunt for Ziro" of chorus girls in costume]]
Huttese slave-girl costumes first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], where versions were worn by actress [[Carrie Fisher]] and stunt performer [[Tracey Eddon]]. The [[Wikipedia:Bikini|bikini]]-style costume consisted of a [[Wikipedia:Brassiere|brassiere]], a skirt made with maroon [[Wikipedia:Silk|silk]] [[Wikipedia:Veil|veils]], [[Wikipedia:Suede|suede]] [[Wikipedia:Boot|boots]], matching jewelry, and hair accessories.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The costume was designed by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] and [[Aggie Guerard Rodgers]], and the faux metal elements were sculpted by [[Richard Miller]].<ref name="Making of ROTJ">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The costumes were first identified as a Huttese slave-girl costume in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="Shield of Lies" />

In the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the costume was made of two items, a "Metal Bikini" and an "Extremely Revealing Skirt." It could be crafted by players in a range of colors.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
